decisions.rationale: Gatehouse arch over a 10 m road between two round towers: a segmental vault springing at 6.8 m, voussoirs, a raised portcullis and a crenellated wall-walk; its ends run 3 m into the towers; 418 triangles, 35,388 bytes before meshopt. Nothing of it comes below 6.8 m and its end faces lie inside the round gate towers (world-v3-castles test); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: The portcullis is fixed in its raised position; gates have no doors.
The vault's underside is the same castle layer, without ribs or murder holes.
Masonry is the castle surface layer tiled every 3 m and the moss layer every 2 m; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decal per piece.

decisions.rationale: In every castle gate (the citadel's Crownbridge gate and one per road at the Old Fort); presentation only, it never collides, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss, with shadows on the level castle ground. The sightline cutaway shows the hero through it (castle browser suite: 100% of hero pixels visible behind a citadel curtain with the cutaway, 0.4% without), and a camera inside its bounds plus 2 m hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Castles and ruins are scenery: no doors open, no interiors and no reachable walls or towers.
